chatgpt.label: ChatGPT
chatgpt.prompt:
Use the uploaded photo as the identity reference and transform the reference person into a hyper-realistic cinematic scene inside a clean, modern office, while preserving their exact identity, facial structure, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, and natural appearance.

The person is a young Iranian man with a natural, realistic appearance, wearing a simple black outfit. He is positioned beneath the camera and looks directly into the lens with a slightly tense, surprised, urgent expression. One arm reaches dramatically toward the camera, with the hand extremely close to the lens and heavily foreshortened, creating a powerful exaggerated foreground perspective.

Camera position: directly above the subject, looking steeply downward.
Lens: extreme 14mm fisheye / ultra-wide-angle perspective.
Composition: dynamic vertical composition with the reaching hand dominating the foreground while the person's face remains clearly visible and recognizable in the center of the scene.

Create a sophisticated, clean modern office environment. The room must be organized and realistic, with no trash, no garbage, no dirty floor, and no unnecessary clutter.

Around the person, make the following objects appear to be floating naturally in mid-air as if gravity has temporarily disappeared:
- a modern laptop
- a smartphone
- an open notebook
- handwritten notes
- loose office papers
- a black professional briefcase
- pens and small stationery items
- several clean documents and printed pages

The floating objects should have different distances from the camera, creating strong foreground, midground, and background depth. Some objects should be very close to the lens and partially cropped, while others should float farther away around the subject.

The laptop, smartphone, notebook, briefcase, papers and stationery must look physically realistic, with natural materials, accurate reflections, realistic shadows, and believable floating positions.

Do NOT include coffee, coffee cups, spilled liquid, food, garbage, trash bags, dirty objects, or debris anywhere in the scene.

The office itself should remain clean, elegant and professional, with a wooden desk, organized workspace, subtle office furniture, realistic walls, shelving and soft ambient architectural lighting.

Create a convincing frozen-in-time / zero-gravity effect. Every floating object must have realistic orientation and spatial depth rather than looking randomly pasted into the scene.

Lighting: cinematic professional lighting, realistic soft key light, subtle rim lighting, natural ambient shadows, realistic skin illumination, high dynamic range, controlled contrast.

Photography style: hyper-realistic professional photography, cinematic editorial photography, physically accurate materials, realistic skin texture, natural pores, realistic hair strands, realistic fabric texture, authentic lens distortion.

Depth of field: cinematic shallow-to-moderate depth of field while keeping the face recognizable and the main floating objects sufficiently detailed.

Color grading: premium cinematic color grading, natural skin tones, realistic neutral office colors, subtle contrast, no excessive saturation.

The final image must look like a real photograph captured with a professional full-frame camera and an ultra-wide 14mm fisheye lens, not CGI, not illustration, not 3D rendering.

Vertical 9:16 composition.
Ultra-detailed.
Photorealistic.
Cinematic.
High dynamic range.
8K-quality detail.

Most important:
Preserve the person's identity exactly.
Do not change the face.
Do not beautify or redesign the facial structure.
Do not change the person's age.
Do not change skin tone.
Do not change hairstyle.
Do not replace the person with another person.

No text, no watermark, no logo.
